name: scriptorium
description: Elastic-loop document extraction team: tiered text/OCR/image extraction agents run in parallel page batches, an independent quality grader, and a queue orchestrator. PDF, pptx, docx, xlsx, HTML, and standalone images in (Markdown, HTML, OKF multi-file bundle, or ReqIF out); more formats arrive as sibling skills.

ocr_languages.title: Extra OCR languages
ocr_languages.description: Comma-separated tesseract language codes (e.g. "deu,fra") to always ensure are installed. OSD script detection alone can't tell German from English — both are Latin script — so list any non-English languages your documents use here.
